items.title: Emmett Johnson: Ticketed for lead-back duties again Week 11
items.text:
With Kenneth Walker (groin) ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Johnson is in line to handle workhorse duties for the second straight week, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Listed as questionable versus Denver
items.text:
Coach Klint Kubiak said Friday that Bowers (ankle) is slated to be listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Caleb Douglas: Will play Sunday
items.text:
Douglas (shoulder) will play Sunday against the Bills, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kenneth Walker: Ruled out for Sunday's game
items.text:
Walker (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Wants to play Monday
items.text:
Croskey-Merritt (groin) said Friday he's taking things "day by day," but his goal is to play Monday against the Bengals, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Ready to return in Week 11
items.text:
Monangai (toe) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game against the Saints.
